mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 76 degrees with partly cloudy skies at Harriet Park, and an air quality index reading of 56, which is in the moderate range.

The City of Verona reports that phase two of road construction on Highway M begins the week of September 7, bringing traffic shifts and lane changes. Additionally, an investigation into a 2019 incident led to the arrest of a school staff member this past Friday.
There is plenty to do, with the Dane County Farmers Market taking place today, plus live music performances at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company all happening today.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Sunday, August 30, they received information regarding an inappropriate relationship from 2019, which led to the arrest of 34-year-old Halla Nelson this past Friday.
Today's flavor of the day is the refreshing Mint Cookie. Culver's is open now and will remain open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
